_deploymentCache.description:
Holds {@link Engine.Deployment} object for current instance of {@link Engine}.

For internal use only!

This object may differ from what is stored in the config framework (until it's updated by {@link Engine.Controller}).
Value in config framework may be missing if the engine is been {@link #terminate terminated}.

_onStartError.description: Errors that are captured during engine start

title:
This type is a wrapper around {@link Engine} that helps expose a simple interface for serving the APIs on a
single {@link Obj} instance. {@link GenaiCore.TypeProxyEngine.DeployBase} contains all of the key fields for
this engine.
If an initialization action name is provided, then that action will be called on the instance at the start of
each of this engine's interpreter threads.
{@link #createFromObj} is the primary constructor, and {@link #callAction} is the primary API to call actions
on the obj instance served through the engine.
@see GenaiCore.Embedder.Engine
name: GenaiCore.TypeProxyEngine
